silhouette.reason: Mid-production Tiger I: slab hull with panniers, interleaved running gear, horseshoe turret with low cupola, mantlet, long 88 with muzzle brake, exhaust covers; reads from every view.
fixes: round the mantlet top/bottom edges (cast radius)

proportions.reason: 8.7 x 3.6 x 3.0 m against 8.45 x 3.56 x 3.00; the +3% is documented in the README (gun-forward figure, rear fittings).
fixes: none needed beyond the documented length; a rear elevation overlay to confirm the exhaust cover height

materials.reason: Camo is soft-edged sprayed bands of green and red-brown over Dunkelgelb, now carried down the barrel as olive and red-brown sleeves sitting on the tube (hero.png, sheet SIDE); Zimmerit corrugation reads; a scatter of small red-brown chip spots remains on turret and hull, and the road wheels are still pale paint with only a faint darker rim.
fixes: dark rubber rims on the road wheels that read in SIDE
drop the small red-brown spot scatter (it fights the bands)

detail.reason: Raking.png: Zimmerit relief, tow cables, tools, spare links on the turret, cupola, mantlet, deck grilles, exhaust covers, lights, number and cross.

wear.reason: Mud and dust on the lower hull nose and running gear, heavier low down; still no exhaust soot on the rear deck or exhaust covers.
fixes: exhaust soot on the rear deck and exhaust covers

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 carries the same soft camo bands, number and cross; the interleaved wheels still become a single row of separated discs.
fixes: keep the wheel rows as overlapping discs at LOD2

technical.reason: QA PASS: 54.9k / 16.4k / 1.4k tris, 25 / 25 / 25 draws (moving pivots), one material.
